action_summary: Replace single-view inference with a fixed four-view probability ensemble: original and horizontal mirror at weight 0.40 each, plus full-image 0.96-scale reflected-padding views at weight 0.10 each. This gives a credible opportunity to reduce orientation/framing sensitivity while retaining all tube tips and keeping most weight on the checkpoint's original scale. Preserve the supplied checkpoint, Kaggle paths, 750-pixel input, zero-to-one normalization, sample-submission order, and submission.csv format. Decode images once with bounded buffering, evaluate views sequentially, save member predictions and metadata, and remove exploratory plots and activation inference. The planning checklist was applied to this inference-only setting: no new training, fabricated OOF scores, loss changes, or fitted ensemble weights are introduced without checkpoint split provenance. No training or inference was run, and a leaderboard improvement cannot be measured locally.
